name: Concrete Compressive Strength Benchmark Dataset
description: The Concrete Compressive Strength dataset contains 1,030 experimental mixture observations describing the non-linear relationship between concrete component proportions (cement, blast furnace slag, fly ash, water, superplasticizer, coarse aggregate, fine aggregate, curing age in days) and resultant compressive strength in megapascals (MPa).
